prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: I was in Shanghai back in 2025 and it felt like every other conversation was about where to eat and who to call for repairs at home.
My neighbor even sent me a screenshot of their home visit details—date was 2025-03-25 and they picked the morning slot, but it was all already handled.
They said the tech showed up to Room 106, Building B, South Apartment, and the contact phone on the order was 13845678901—nothing for me to do, just gossip.
And then that same week my coworker was bragging they’d already booked Xiao Nan Guo for dinner on 2025-03-23, like it was some huge achievement.
They went at 19:00 and it was just party size 2—honestly sounded cozy, but it’s long done now.
Oh, and for that reservation it was under Chen Ming with 13830018365, and separately I remember Li Na had already reserved the book Deep Learning—everyone was super organized except me.
